name: quietscore
description: Private CVSS 4.0 calculator and Rust/WebAssembly MCP tools

scripts.build: python3 scripts/metrics.py && node scripts/generate-tables.cjs && cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && node scripts/package.cjs
scripts.test: cargo test && node scripts/verify-sources.cjs && node scripts/verify.cjs && node scripts/verify-files.cjs && tsx --test tests/*.test.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write bridge.js style.css scripts mcp worker tests package.json samples.json README.md && cargo fmt && rustfmt src/xlsx.rs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check bridge.js style.css scripts mcp worker tests package.json samples.json README.md && cargo fmt --check && rustfmt --check src/xlsx.rs
